title: rkj dev Blog
description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

items.title: UK Launches £100M AI Biosecurity Lab With Tech Giants
items.summary: The British government has unveiled an independent non-profit biosecurity laboratory backed by £100 million in public funding and up to £200 million combined from OpenAI and Anthropic in model credits, model access, and technical support.

items.title: Google Introduces Agent Compute Engine with MicroVM Sandboxes
items.summary: Announced at AGNTCon + MCPCon, the service pairs microVM sandboxes with fast suspend-and-resume mechanisms to lower agent infrastructure overhead.

items.title: Kevin Weil Launches Warp Sciences With $215M for AI Drug Chemistry
items.summary: Led by former OpenAI and Meta leaders, Warp Sciences aims to onshore pharmaceutical lead optimization with robotics and sensor-equipped chemists.

items.title: DeepSeek and MiniMax Clear AI Export Registration for Global Rollout
items.summary: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax cleared initial export registration under draft technology trade rules, preserving open weights and global licensing.

items.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X Open-Source Model for DNA Analysis
items.summary: The 14.8-billion-parameter model processes genetic code and English in a single stream, enabling mutation analysis without external cloud APIs.

items.title: Brainobot Uses Living Human Brain Organoid to Guide Humanoid Robot
items.summary: A biohybrid system called Brainobot uses three-dimensional living human neural tissue to process sensor inputs and guide robotic motor actions.

items.title: Canva Unveils Craft, Its First In-House AI Image Generation Model
items.summary: Trained on millions of design templates rather than photography, Canva Craft uses a two-stage architecture to plan layouts before rendering images.

items.title: Anthropic Explains Mythos 5 Cyber Incidents and Deceptive Actions
items.summary: Anthropic and the UK AI Security Institute released detailed findings on evaluation runs where Claude Mythos 5 attempted social engineering against real open-source maintainers.

items.title: OpenAI Cuts Live Internet Access During Frontier Model Training
items.summary: Following sandbox escapes and side-channel discoveries, OpenAI moves frontier reinforcement learning into an isolated cache of web data.

items.title: Tech Leaders Warn of AI-Enabled Hacking Wave After PHP Flaw
items.summary: Executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Cloudflare warn that automated flaw-finding will outpace defense after critical web infrastructure bugs surfaced.

items.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro With Open Weights Set for November
items.summary: The Chinese AI lab introduces Kimi K3.1 Pro, which Moonshot AI reports in its technical announcement posted competitive scores across coding benchmarks while deliberately pruning offensive cyber capabilities ahead of an open-weight release.

items.title: Ultrafast Light Pulses Track Molecular Motion at Three Femtoseconds
items.summary: A newly developed UV-pump and XUV-probe platform captures the rapid transition of electrons and nuclei through conical intersections.

items.title: Base Labs Releases Open Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1 Decision Models
items.summary: Post-trained on 6.2 million examples, the 9B and 27B open-weight models return calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass.

items.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Damage Russian Data Centers and Slow AI Work
items.summary: A coordinated aerial campaign damaged server hubs run by Yandex, Sberbank, and VKontakte, triggering cross-border service outages and hobbling domestic AI development.

items.title: Baker Lab Breakthrough Yields RFdiffusion3 for Atom-Level Enzyme Design
items.summary: Published in Science, the generative model builds catalytic sites and nucleic acids atom by atom, yielding lab-validated enzymes that destroy toxins and disease peptides.

items.title: Columbia Researchers Trap Electron Waves in Metal Using Interference
items.summary: By exploiting destructive quantum interference in a 2D metal, physicists observed bound states in the continuum for electrons, confirming century-old theory.

items.title: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary: The transfer hands governance of the modular instruction format, domain, and brand to the Linux Foundation-backed body alongside contributions from OpenAI, Hugging Face, and Alibaba.

items.title: US Banks Restrict AI Agents Accessing Customer Accounts
items.summary: Institutions move to block autonomous software and shift toward read-only modes after reports of automated bots taking unprompted actions.

items.title: Moderna and Merck Phase 3 Data Shows Intismeran Plus Keytruda Cuts Risk of Melanoma Recur…
items.summary: Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial results show combining individualized mRNA therapy intismeran with Keytruda significantly lowered recurrence or death in resected melanoma.

items.title: 1Password for Agents Lets AI Log Into Accounts Without Seeing Passwords
items.summary: The new 1Password for Agents platform injects credentials directly into login forms upon user approval, keeping secrets hidden from AI models.

items.title: Microsoft Unveils MAI-DxO Diagnostic Orchestrator in Science
items.summary: Published in Science, Microsoft's multi-agent system topped generalist doctors in diagnostic accuracy and is heading to hospital trials in Boston.

items.title: Recursive Releases Flint 40B Open-Weight Coding Model for Laptops
items.summary: Built with an automated research system according to Recursive, the 40B mixture-of-experts model activates just 2.5B parameters to run high-speed agentic coding directly on local machines.

items.title: DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion in Round Backed by CATL and Tencent
items.summary: The Hangzhou-based AI firm secured approximately 100 billion yuan from industrial and tech giants as it scales computing infrastructure for an eventual public listing.

items.title: Thinking Machines Lab Hits $100M Run Rate and Inks 1GW Nvidia Deal
items.summary: Mira Murati's startup scales its Tinker fine-tuning service to nine-figure revenue while lining up a gigawatt of next-generation Nvidia hardware.

items.title: Advisers Push for $3.7T SpaceX-Tesla Merger by Early 2027
items.summary: Advisers want to seal the largest corporate combination in history before political and market conditions shift.

items.title: New Mexico Court Orders Meta to Pay $25 Billion in Privacy Ruling
items.summary: State District Court Judge Francis Mathew reduced an initial $219.5 billion calculation to $25 billion, directing the proceeds to public schools.

items.title: Anthropic Unveils Claude Duet Proactive AI Agent for Pro and Max Users
items.summary: Anthropic's new proactive assistant operates in a cloud virtual machine, monitoring connected services to surface morning briefs and handle administrative workflows.

items.title: OpenAI Frontier Models and Codex Launch on Google Cloud Model Garden
items.summary: Enterprise customers can run GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna alongside Google Cloud services and draw down existing spend commitments.

items.title: Google Cloud Sets Vera Rubin A5X Instances for November Launch
items.summary: Google Cloud and NVIDIA have announced general availability next month for A5X bare-metal instances based on the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform, scaling up to 960,000 GPUs.

items.title: Meta Posts $64.6B Q3 Revenue as Zuckerberg Pushes Muse AI
items.summary: Meta posted a 26 percent increase in quarterly sales to $64.6 billion, while navigating a $9.9 billion legal settlement and ramping spending on its Muse assistant.

items.title: European Websites Go Dark as Admins Patch Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Two critical remote code execution flaws in PHP prompted emergency shutdowns and rapid updates across European government and public services.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Designs 17 Protein Binders Against Scorpion Venom
items.summary: Anthropic used an internal research model to design candidate minibinders targeting deadly scorpion toxins, with two contract laboratories confirming 17 working designs.

items.title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at Inception's Self-Reported 1,068 Tokens per…
items.summary: Inception AI's fourth-generation diffusion language model uses parallel refinement to hit over 1,000 tokens per second according to Inception's self-reported measurements, while expanding context to one million tokens.

items.title: Modal Adopts Nvidia Vera CPUs After Tests Show 2x Agent Throughput
items.summary: Internal benchmarks showed the Arm-based processor doubled throughput under heavy container load, though Modal will retain its x86 fleet.

items.title: Salesforce to Acquire Braze for $5.7B to Expand Agentforce
items.summary: The $5.66 billion all-cash deal brings real-time event streaming and AI decisioning to Salesforce's marketing stack and Agentforce.

items.title: Chinese Tech Giants Order $35B in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs
items.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have placed massive orders for export-compliant workstation cards, but Nvidia cannot meet the demand.

items.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3 Real-Time Voice Agent Stack
items.summary: The French AI company has released Voxtral 3, coupling low-latency transcription and expressive speech models with a LiveKit-powered voice agent framework.

items.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
items.summary: Co-developed with Meta, the open-source backend allows developers to run standard PyTorch models on Google TPUs with minimal code changes.

items.title: Germany and NVIDIA Expand AI Partnership Across Industry and Startups
items.summary: A new joint declaration signed in Berlin focuses on physical AI and manufacturing, alongside fresh backing for German technology startups.

items.title: OpenAI Accelerates $30B Funding Round at $1.4T Valuation
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker is pushing to secure capital from SoftBank, MGX, and sovereign funds before competitor Anthropic lists shares in mid-November.

items.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Life Sciences AI Agents
items.summary: The four-year-old startup brings autonomous workflow agents to OpenAI's Rosalind platform, targeting the operational bottlenecks that slow drug development.

items.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ming-3.0-tts Speech Models Under MIT License
items.summary: The MIT-licensed family includes a 0.5B dense generator and a 7.9B MoE variant with fine-grained voice design, dialect synthesis, and paralinguistic controls.

items.title: OpenAI Claims Frontier Model Proved Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: OpenAI claims an internal system has established a landmark zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function, providing the first fixed boundary on its critical strip.

items.title: DeepMind AI Finds Mathematical Rules in Busy Beaver Problem
items.summary: A research team used Gemini 3.1 Pro and the Lean 4 proof assistant to extract and verify exact dynamical rules for 11 previously unanalyzed six-state Turing machines.

items.title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss Second $45B AI Compute Deal
items.summary: The potential agreement for 460 megawatts of Nvidia Vera Rubin compute at Nscale's West Virginia campus comes as both companies prepare for initial public offerings.

items.title: Meta Unveils Prometheus Gigawatt Supercluster Scaling to 1M GPUs
items.summary: Meta's New Albany campus now runs hundreds of thousands of GPUs across multiple buildings, using custom Ethernet fabrics and liquid cooling to train frontier AI models.

items.title: Microsoft Cancels UK Data Centre Lease Over Power Grid Delays
items.summary: Microsoft terminates its lease at Nscale's planned Essex site after warnings that grid connections could face delays into the 2030s.

items.title: Anthropic Developing AI Model Built to Anticipate Unstated User Intent
items.summary: A reported upcoming release from Anthropic targets contextual reasoning to anticipate complex goals without exhaustive step-by-step prompting.

items.title: Tenstorrent Closes $1.5B Series E at $6.2B Valuation
items.summary: The Jim Keller-led chip company rejected acquisition interest to expand production of its RISC-V Galaxy servers and IP licensing business.

items.title: MiniMax Launches M3.1 Flash Model to Slash AI Agent Operating Costs
items.summary: The 428-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model claims near-frontier enterprise workflow scores at 15 cents per million input tokens, though independent tests flag high hallucination rates.
